payload.original_promise: Determine whether a signed Technocore room record can be independently re-verified using only the current public server response.

test_results.evaluation: The fresh worker DID is distinct from issuer and verifier; the exact request signature over room|nonce|text verifies locally.
test_results.pass_condition: A fresh isolated Ed25519 did:key signs the exact Technocore canonical message and an independent local check validates that signature.

test_results.evaluation: The preserved evidence records one accepted HTTP 200 write and an HTTP 200 JSON read whose sole record matches the full DID, nonce, and swept text.
test_results.pass_condition: The live Technocore service accepts the signed write and its JSON room response returns the same full DID, nonce, and swept text.

test_results.evaluation: The returned stored record contains no sig or signature field.
test_results.pass_condition: The live JSON room response retains the original signature for the stored record.

test_results.evaluation: Using only the server response, the canonical message can be reconstructed but the required signature bytes are absent, so cryptographic re-verification cannot be executed. No signature was borrowed from the worker request.
test_results.pass_condition: A reader with only the public JSON room response and the published protocol can cryptographically re-verify the stored record without trusting the ingest event or using worker-held evidence.
